description.value: Day to Day Grocery & Produce is a large South Asian wholesale cash-and-carry grocery chain with multiple BC locations, including this Langley branch near Willowbrook Mall. The store stocks over 5,000 products under one roof, specialising in South Asian staples such as premium basmati rice, exotic spices, Ayurvedic herbs, and fresh produce sourced from India and elsewhere. A touring cyclist looking to restock on a wide variety of groceries, fruits, and pantry items would find this one of the larger options in the Langley area.
